note: Vanuatu: nationals of the countries on the Department of Immigration and Passport Services' list of exempted countries need no visitor visa beforehand and are given a tourist visa on arrival, for a stay of up to 120 days that can't be extended; everyone else applies for the tourist visa in advance, from outside Vanuatu (taken as an e-Visa). Read on 2026-11-03 from the Department's own pages, which corrected Wikipedia's copy, read before, on the form (a visa given on arrival, not entry without one) and on Cameroon and Mozambique (on its list of non-exempted countries) and Macao (on neither list), which apply in advance. Its two lists both name Bahrain, Monaco, Rwanda and Turkey; they are kept as exempted, as Wikipedia's copy has them.

sources.title: Vanuatu Department of Immigration and Passport Services, Tourist Visa
sources.said: The period of stay allowed is 120 days without the possibility of extension. ... The visa holder must exit the country before the expiry of the 120-day period. Tourist Visa Grant Criteria Tourist visas can be obtained upon arrival for travelers from exempted countries (see list of exempted countries) ... The applicant must be outside of Vanuatu at the time of application.
